name: coggit-monorepo
description: CogGit monorepo: source-linked Markdown cognition files with freshness status, evidence, and MCP tools for agent workflows.

scripts.compile: pnpm run build && pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && pnpm --filter coggit-vscode run package
scripts.lint: eslint packages/vscode/src packages/core/src packages/runtime-node/src packages/format/src packages/mcp/src packages/mcp-runtime-support/src packages/cli/src
scripts.test:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --outDir out && node scripts/copy-test-assets.js
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:compile && mocha
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run compile && pnpm run test:compile && pnpm exec vscode-test
